errors.CANNOT_DEMOTE_LAST_ADMIN: This is the only administrator in the organization, and an organization always keeps at least one — demoting them would leave nobody able to manage members, addresses or approvals. Promote another member to administrator first, and then this role can be changed.
errors.CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_ADMIN: This is the only administrator in the organization, and an organization always keeps at least one — removing them would leave nobody able to manage members, addresses or approvals. Promote another member to administrator first, and then this one can be removed.
errors.CUSTOMER_ALREADY_DELETED: This customer account has already been deleted, so this action is not available for it. A deleted account can be restored until its restore window elapses.
errors.CUSTOMER_AUTHENTICATION_THROTTLED: Too many attempts were made for this account, so further attempts are paused for a few minutes. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CUSTOMER_AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILAB: Signing in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.CUSTOMER_RESTORE_WINDOW_ELAPSED: The restore window for this account has elapsed, so it can no longer be restored. Its personal data has been, or will shortly be, permanently anonymized.
